products.name: Varanasi Royal Crimson Katan Silk Saree
products.description: Handwoven in the ancient ghats of Varanasi, this crimson red Katan silk saree is embellished with antique gold zari shikargah motifs depicting floral vines and peacocks.
products.details: Woven with 100% pure Mulberry silk warp and weft. Features an ornate pallu with traditional meenakari detailing. Includes an unstitched matching blouse piece with zari border.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store wrapped in pure cotton or muslin fabric. Avoid perfume spray directly on zari.

products.name: Kanchipuram Temple Border Gold Tissue Saree
products.description: A masterpiece from Tamil Nadu weavers, woven in shimmering gold tissue with a contrasting ruby red Korvai temple border and intricate rudraksha motifs.
products.details: Pure gold zari thread woven into high-density silk warp. Heavy bridal pallu featuring Gajalakshmi motifs.
products.careInstructions: Strictly dry clean. Periodic refolding along natural creases prevents zari breakage.

products.name: Pastel Mint Organza Hand-Embroidered Saree
products.description: Ethereal sheer mint green organza saree adorned with delicate pearl cutwork, sequin embroidery, and scalloped borders.
products.details: Lightweight gossamer drape ideal for summer cocktail soirées and sangeet celebrations. Paired with an unstitched dupion silk blouse fabric.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Steam iron on reverse at low heat.

products.name: Chanderi Zari Buti Midnight Blue Saree
products.description: Heritage Chanderi silk cotton saree dipped in deep midnight indigo, highlighted with hand-punched gold and silver coin (ashrafi) butis.
products.details: Feather-light texture with subtle sheen. 6.5 meters including running blouse fabric.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Gentle hand wash in cold water with mild detergent.

products.name: Royal Maroon Velvet Heritage Bridal Lehenga
products.description: Crafted for the quintessential royal bride, this bespoke maroon velvet lehenga features micro-zardozi handwork, dabka embroidery, and semi-precious bead detailing.
products.details: Includes a structured 16-kali velvet skirt with double can-can lining, sweetheart neckline blouse, and dual dupattas (one heavy velvet veil and one soft peach tulle dupatta).
products.careInstructions: Specialist dry clean only. Preserve in bridal trunk with cedarwood balls.

products.name: Dusty Rose Mirror-Work Chikankari Lehenga
products.description: Meticulously embroidered by Lucknowi craftswomen with 32 distinct stitches of chikankari, accentuated with real foil mirror reflections and champagne sequins.
products.details: Lightweight silk georgette with voluminous flare. Paired with a contemporary halter-neck blouse and crushed organza dupatta.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Iron inside out.

products.name: Emerald Green Brocade Banarasi Lehenga Set
products.description: Lustrous emerald green Banarasi silk brocade skirt woven with royal jaal patterns in spun gold thread, complemented with an elbow-sleeve choli and tissue dupatta.
products.details: High-waisted silhouette with handcrafted latkan tassels. Built-in can-can layer for structural regal flare.

products.name: Sunflower Yellow Gota Patti Haldi Lehenga
products.description: Vibrant celebratory yellow georgette lehenga tailored with traditional Rajasthani gota patti borders, mirror accents, and a flowing scalloped hemline.
products.details: Light and dance-friendly. Comes with sweetheart neck blouse and matching net dupatta.

products.name: Ivory Raw Silk Angrakha Kurta Set
products.description: Graceful crossover Angrakha silhouette in ivory raw silk, accented with subtle zari stitching, handmade potli buttons, and paired with straight pants.
products.details: Features a sheer organza dupatta finished with pearl tassels. Pure cotton lining for absolute comfort.

products.name: Rani Pink Chanderi Kurta & Palazzo Suit
products.description: Luminous deep pink handloom Chanderi kurta framed with intricate neckline tilla embroidery, paired with wide-legged palazzo trousers.
products.details: 3-piece ensemble: Kurta, Palazzo, and Printed Silk Dupatta. Concealed side zipper on trousers.

products.name: Teal Blue Velvet Embroidered Winter Suit
products.description: Sumptuous jewel-toned teal velvet straight kurta with antique dabka and sequin borders, paired with cigarette pants and a banarasi zari shawl.
products.details: Fully lined with soft satin. Ideal for royal winter destination weddings.

products.name: Imperial Wine Floor-Length Anarkali Gown
products.description: An architectural silhouette with 24 flared kalis in deep wine georgette, embellished with hand-cut zardozi floral vines along the bodice and hemline.
products.details: Floor-sweeping 5-meter flare with lightweight structured petticoat. Accompanied by a matching churidar and embellished tulle veil.

products.name: Golden Sand Kalidar Chiffon Anarkali
products.description: Shimmering metallic gold chiffon flared anarkali layered with soft mulmul, highlighted with intricate threadwork and mukaish embellishments.
products.details: Lightweight movement with royal court drape. Paired with tonal churidar and badla dupatta.

products.name: Royal Heritage Brocade Groom Sherwani
products.description: Regal ivory and antique gold Banarasi woven sherwani featuring bespoke crested metal buttons, mandarin collar, and discreet structured padding.
products.details: 4-piece groom couture set: Sherwani coat, inner raw silk kurta, matching churidar, and an embroidered silk stole with handcrafted fringe.
products.careInstructions: Specialist dry clean only. Store on wide wooden hanger inside garment bag.

products.name: Midnight Onyx Velvet Hand-Embroidered Sherwani
products.description: Sophisticated modern silhouette in jet-black micro-velvet, detailed with monochrome tone-on-tone thread embroidery and matte black metallic buttons.
products.details: Tailored for the groom or reception evening. Comes with tapered slim-fit trousers and pocket square.
products.fabric: Italian Micro Velvet & Silk Acetate Lining

products.name: Blush Rose Jamawar Silk Sherwani
products.description: Refined pastel menswear in blush pink pure Jamawar silk weave, adorned with subtle Kashmiri paisley motifs and mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.details: Pairs harmoniously with pastel bridal ensembles. Complete with churidar and lightweight organza stole.

products.name: Lucknowi Hand-Embroidered Chikan Silk Kurta
products.description: Pure chanderi silk men’s kurta featuring authentic Bakhiya and Phanda stitch chikankari on the chest and cuffs, matched with cotton-silk churidar.
products.details: Comfortable relaxed tailoring with side slits. High-grade mother-of-pearl button placket.
products.careInstructions: Dry clean or gentle hand wash.

products.name: Raw Silk Kurta with Embroidered Bundi Jacket
products.description: Earthy rust raw silk kurta paired with a structured Nehru waist-coat (Bundi) featuring woven floral vines and antique brass buttons.
products.details: Versatile 3-piece set (Kurta, Bundi Jacket, and Slim Trousers).

products.name: Olive Khadi Silk Asymmetric Festive Kurta
products.description: Modern asymmetric hemline kurta in olive green handloom khadi silk with side-button placket and tonal stitch lines.
products.details: Lightweight breathable texture with contemporary draped cut. Pairs well with dhotis or linen trousers.
products.careInstructions: Gentle hand wash in cold water.

products.name: Draped Pre-Stitched Concept Saree with Embroidered Belt
products.description: A revolutionary contemporary take on the timeless saree: pre-pleated satin georgette drape secured with an ornate pearl and zardozi embellished belt.
products.details: Includes structured bustier blouse with pearl drop tassels. Slips on effortlessly in 60 seconds.
products.tags: Concept Saree,Ready to Wear,Indo Western,Cocktail Gala

products.name: Cape Lehenga Set with Sheer Embroidered Shrug
products.description: Three-piece indo-western ensemble featuring a flared crepe skirt, bustier top, and a dramatically sweeping organza cape shrug adorned with gold fringes.
products.details: Duptta-free contemporary convenience for modern celebrations.

products.name: Men’s Asymmetric Indo-Western Jacket & Jodhpuris
products.description: Charcoal grey structured Indo-Western coat with diagonal overlap front, metallic brooch fastening, and tailored equestrian Jodhpuri trousers.
products.details: Sharp Italian suiting fabric infused with Indian royal silhouette.

products.name: Handcrafted Zardozi Bridal Potli Bag
products.description: Luxe velvet drawstring potli bag meticulously hand-embroidered with floral zardozi bullion wires and cascading pearl tassels.
products.details: Comfortably fits smartphones, makeup essentials, and keys. Braided gold chain wrist handle.
products.careInstructions: Spot clean only. Store in protective dust bag.

reviews.title: Heirloom quality! Truly royal experience.
reviews.comment: I ordered this saree for my sister’s wedding in Udaipur. The pure silk drape and the weight of the zari are breathtaking. Received compliments all evening. Packaging came in a beautiful ivory velvet box!

reviews.title: Made my wedding day magical.
reviews.comment: The zardozi embroidery is so fine and intricate. Even better in person than in the photos. The double dupatta draping gave me the exact royal maharani look I wanted. Thank you EthnizCouture!

reviews.title: Exquisite cut and silk texture.
reviews.comment: Fits true to size with subtle gold accents that feel understated yet undeniably luxurious. The organza dupatta is so soft and light.

reviews.title: Exceptional craftsmanship and fit.
reviews.comment: Ordered for our wedding pheras. The brocade is genuine Banarasi weave and the structured cut looks sharp and dignified. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Pure comfort and artisanal elegance.
reviews.comment: The hand chikankari stitches are flawless. You can feel the hours of human craft in every centimeter. Perfect for festive dinners.
